data.one_liner: A pure Dart chess logic package with flexible variant support.
data.what_it_does: Provides chess logic, legal move generation, FEN/PGN import/output, and support for over 50 built-in chess variants and custom fairy pieces. Written in pure Dart with zero dependencies.
use_when: You are building a chess game or custom chess variant in Dart or Flutter.
You need move generation, FEN parsing, and rules management without external dependencies.
avoid_when: You need a complete UI chessboard widget (use the companion 'squares' package instead).
strengths: Flexible variant and fairy piece support via Betza notation and custom rules.
Zero dependencies and pure Dart implementation.
Over 50 built-in variants including Chess960, Crazyhouse, and Xiangqi.
weaknesses: Does not include UI widgets out of the box (requires a separate chessboard UI package).
